name: Molecular Medicine PhD Program (Cleveland Clinic Lerner Research Institute)
summary: Molecular Medicine PhD at Cleveland Clinic integrating laboratory research with human disease and clinical/translational training.

publishedDeadlines.label: Application deadline (safer earlier source)
publishedDeadlines.note: Application page; no year. FAQ instead says January5. Confirm with program and plan for earlier deadline.

english.toefl: 5.0 on or after January21,2026; 90 iBT earlier; 577 paper
english.note: PTE Academic61 also accepted. Scores valid two years. TOEFL Home Edition accepted; Duolingo, IELTS Indicator/One Skill Retake, TOEFL Essentials/MyBest not accepted. A bachelor or master degree taught primarily in English may qualify for an exemption.

applicationFee.note: Program FAQ states$50; generic Graduate Studies instructions state$85. Confirm amount in application. Program accepts MMED application fee waiver requests; international eligibility not expressly restricted, confirm.

requirements.note: General biology, general chemistry, organic chemistry and biochemistry with C−or better before entry; molecular/cellular biology recommended. One reference from current research mentor. All English tests completed by deadline. Competitive candidates interviewed; final decisions by February. First year begins mid-July.

funding.note: All accepted students receive stipend and free tuition throughout graduate training plus CWRU health insurance. Amount not stated on opened program pages.

detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.
